meta.name: design-is
meta.description: Audit a design against Dieter Rams' ten "Good design is..." principles, then hand off a /make-plan prompt for one of three outcomes — new design, refine design, or redesign. Use when the user says "audit this design", "design review", "check this UI against Rams", "is this UI good", "critique this design", "design audit", or asks for a critique that should lead to a plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对照迪特·拉姆斯十大原则审核设计并生成改进方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要依据经典设计原则来评估和优化界面设计。
copy.tagline_en: Audit designs against Dieter Rams' ten principles and generate improvement plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to evaluate and improve interface designs based on classic design principles.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会对照 Dieter Rams 的十条原则逐条审计设计，每项打 0–3 分并附证据，给出 NEW / REFINE / REDESIGN 判定，最后产出可直接复制运行的 /make-plan 提示。它不写实现代码。
howto.when: 当你说出 “audit this design”、“design review”、“critique this design” 等关键词，或要求做一场能落到计划的设计批评时接管；常规 UI 代码审查、纯文案修改不归它管。

say.text: 审计这个设计，按 Rams 十条原则逐条打分
say.note: 在仓库根目录生成评分卡与结论文件

say.text: 帮我批判这个界面，并给出改进计划
这个 UI 够好吗？跑一遍 design-is 审计
say.note: 每条原则给分并注明证据

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude audits a design against Dieter Rams' ten principles, scores each 0–3 with cited evidence, issues a NEW / REFINE / REDESIGN verdict, and hands off a ready-to-run /make-plan prompt. It does not write implementation code.
howto.when_en: Triggers on “audit this design”, “design review”, “critique this design” and similar, or when you want a critique that should lead to a plan.

say_en.text: Audit this design against the ten Rams principles.
say_en.note: Writes scorecard and verdict files in the repo root.

say_en.text: Critique this UI and give me a plan to fix it.
Is this UI good? Run a design-is audit.
say_en.note: Returns a score per principle, with evidence.
